column1: # Review evaluation corpus — Matomo 6.x-dev only.  Tab-separated; use '-' for an empty field.
# expect: pass | fail | any (verdict the CI review should give; dev: fail = Changes required).
# expect_where: comma-separated path[:line] at head that a gating finding should hit.
# Seeded cases need refs/review-eval/* in the checkout: run eval/make-seeds.py first.
# stage: smoke < pilot < full (run-matrix -t smoke,pilot runs both).

column8: notes
Pilot range. 3 of 4 pilot runs flagged a tab-only-login cleanup regression; the label decides whether it is real.
Reflected XSS: the segment request parameter goes into a JS string in an onclick attribute with HTML escaping only (|e('js') dropped); the browser decodes the entities before running the JS.
Host of s04: keep the selected segment in the goal page segmented visitor log.
login_allow_logme compared with === '0', but the ini reader returns int 0: logme stays enabled although disabled (the default).
Host of s02: answer logme with 404 while it is disabled.

POST hand-off submits to target='overlayIframe', but piwik.js renames the frame once the tracked site loads, so a reload in token-propagation mode opens a new window (major). The HTML-escaped values in the inline JS at index.twig:75,86 predate this commit (fixed later by 5b934e9b57).
Drive-by local rename in untouched private UsersManager\Controller::getTokenAccessLevelOptions. CI must pass; dev should raise DEV-02 under Guardrails at plugins/UsersManager/Controller.php:640.
Update file 6.0.0-b5 added but core version left at 6.0.0-b4: the migration never runs.
The added site access check is Piwik::isUserHasViewAccess with its result ignored: row evolution of any site renders for any user.
Host of s01: check site access before rendering a row evolution.
SQL injection: the login of the unauthenticated unsubscribe request is concatenated into the token lookup.
Stored XSS: tracked outlink URL bound to href without $sanitizeUrl, so a tracked javascript: URL runs on click. dist/ deliberately not rebuilt.
Calendar-day count computed but the old hour-based value still returned: the stated fix has no effect and the added test fails.
Public API parameter copyToUser of Dashboard.copyDashboardToUser renamed to targetLogin: HTTP callers passing copyToUser= break.
Host of s08: tidy up the UsersManager token actions.
Host of s06: 6.0.0-b5 migration with version bump.
Option list teleported to <body>: search box cannot hold focus inside modals, list can open off-screen; fixed by 92061653a7. Contains submodule bumps.

Large (about 1.2k reviewable lines). getPhpVersion() returns the web PHP version from CLI so plugin installs check require.php against the wrong PHP; empty consumer response read as no licenses. Fixed by f8bd463d8d.
PHPDoc-only corrections across core/ and plugins/ plus the matching phpstan baseline removals.
